items: Question Bank: Application of Derivatives subtopic renamed "Mean Value Theorem (Rolle's and Lagrange's)"; 10 more Rolle/MVT questions moved into it (65 in total).
Question Bank: 6 more questions moved to Functions → "Inequalities, Modulus and Logarithmic Equations".

Question Bank: 368 questions moved into their proper subtopics: Tangents and Normals, Functional Equations, number of roots, limits of sequences, binomial distribution and random variables, and the plane, line–plane and sphere subtopics of 3D Geometry.
Question Bank: triple products split into two subtopics, "Scalar Triple Product" (53) and "Vector Triple Product" (27).
Question Bank: new subtopic "Limit as a Sum" in Definite Integration with all 50 limit-of-a-sum questions (3 moved there from the Limits and Application of Derivatives chapters).
Question Bank: every question re-checked for its subtopic; 49 more questions moved to the correct official subtopic. Cengage, VMC, IIT before 2000 and Black Book chapters unchanged.

Question Bank: 61 questions that were in made-up subtopics moved to the correct official subtopic of their chapter; 3 made-up subtopics that became empty were removed. Chapters unchanged; Cengage, VMC and IIT before 2000 not changed.
Login page: on laptops the left side now fills the space up to the dividing line.
Login page: the left side now starts near the left edge and uses the full width up to the dividing line.
Login page: split screen — blue gradient on the left with what the site offers, white on the right with the logo and sign-in, and a coloured line between them.
Login page: logo and title at the top of the right side above the sign-in box; "Free to start · by Ankit Kamboj" below the sign-in box; the headline starts at the top of the left side.
Login page: the headline now starts at the top; the logo and title moved to the bottom. "Free to start · by Ankit Kamboj".

Login page redesigned: a bold headline, a picture of the NTA-style test screen with its timer and question panel, exam badges, a stats strip and colourful feature cards; the sign-in box stays in view on the right.

New login page: everything the site offers on the left (NTA-style online tests, instant reports and ranks, Question Bank, past papers 1978–2026, DPPs, Must Solve, handouts, tools for teachers) and sign-in on the right. On phones the sign-in comes first.
Question Bank: brackets around fractions now grow to fit them in 18 questions (for example the greatest-integer series in JM201904121P109).
Question Bank: in 577 questions, variables, points, matrices and equations that were written as plain text now show as proper maths (Cengage, VMC and IIT questions before 2000 not changed).
Question Bank: fixed 9 more questions with broken maths or typos (for example "I\(f\) …C₄ an\(d\)", "For x x R", "uni t²").
Question Bank: fixed the maths in 19 questions that showed wrongly (for example "se c²θ", "o f ¹⁹C", "c m²", variables and equations typed as plain text).
Question Bank: 4 Black Book questions had two identical options; one option in each was replaced and the answers were checked (all four answer keys are correct).
Question Bank: removed extra spaces and blank lines in 1,093 questions (maths unchanged).
Compact header: on computers the logo, title, tabs and buttons fit in one row; tablets and phones use tighter rows, so more of the page is visible.
Edit profile: students are told to use "Request a school change" to move to another school.

School changes: once a school is chosen, only Avanti staff (@avantifellows.org) can change it themselves. Everyone else uses "Request a school change" in Edit profile, and the admin approves or rejects it in Teacher approvals.
The website version moved from the profile menu to the bottom of Help & Support; tap it to see what changed.
Footer: the website version is shown only to the admin.
Security: a new Student ID that differs from an existing one only by . _ / - is refused, so nobody can sign in to another student's account.
Security: dates of birth in My Students are shown only after the admin approves the teacher's school.
Security: more wrong dates of birth for one Student ID now lock it for 24 hours (the teacher can unlock it by saving the student).
Fixed: opening Results, a report or a test without choosing one now goes to the right list instead of an error.
Fixed: the extra "|" in the footer; teachers no longer see "Class ?" on Available tests; students opening My Students are pointed to their tests.
Saved worksheets: the separate Edit button is removed; use ⋯ → Edit questions.
Question Bank: one Export menu (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Print, Share) next to Create test; Save as worksheet, Create test and Export are white with a blue border.
Saved worksheets: new Edit button to change the title, reorder or remove questions, and add questions by ID.
Save as worksheet can now add the ticked questions to an existing worksheet.
Question Bank: quick filter buttons in two neat rows (4 on top, 3 below).
Solutions status link in the footer is shown only to the admin.
Membership questions in bigger, easier-to-read text.
Teachers' chat: if it cannot connect it now says why, with a Try again button.
New Membership page for teachers and students: a banner with the price per day, Premium benefits with icons, a Free vs Premium comparison, how payment works, and common questions.
Premium members see their days left and can renew; Avanti students and staff see that Premium is included.
Teachers' chat at the bottom right for Premium teachers, Avanti teachers and the admin: see who is online and chat. Messages are not saved.
PYQs: Answer Key and Explanation at the top; Question Paper and Chapterwise as two blocks.
Question Bank: wider filter sidebar.
School lists: one dropdown; the search box appears inside it when you open it.
Footer: the website version opens this list of updates; the Question Bank version is no longer shown.
Test window: the question timer shows only the time.
Profile menu: counts after each item; Create Test moved to My Tests; website version shown at the bottom.
Sharing a PDF now opens a "PDF ready" box: share with an app (phones), download, WhatsApp or Gmail.
Saved worksheets: View questions, an Export menu (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Share) and a More menu (Rename, Delete).
Test window: time spent on each question.
Date of birth visible to teachers in My Students and Edit.
School search box always shown.
Saved worksheets can be downloaded and shared.
School lists get a search box.
Bold text inside questions shows as bold.
Footer shows the website version.
Fixed lists: Category General, Gen-EWS, OBC-NCL, SC, ST · Gender Male, Female, Other · Class 11, 12, Dropper · Stream JEE, NEET, KCET (PCM), KCET (PCB).
Bulk upload converts other spellings after a clear warning, and rejects values it cannot convert.
Bulk upload reads swapped Category / Gender columns and short forms (GEN, OBC, F, M).
Student IDs already registered are skipped, never uploaded twice.
Admin role: only the admin sees every school's students, tests and reports.
Classes, streams and sessions (Class 11 → 2026-28, Class 12 and Dropper → 2026-27).
Tests are open only to the classes, streams and school the teacher chooses.
Students fill their details once; Available tests also lists past tests.
PYQs: compact dropdowns and a full-width preview; DPPs and PYQs share one toolbar.
The old artifact now points here; a safety check stops old code from going live.
Teacher school approval by the admin.
Students added by Avanti teachers get Premium.
Help & Support page and sign-in help.
New plans: students ₹299, teachers ₹599 a year; Avanti students and teachers included.
My Students with performance, Excel / CSV bulk upload and editing.
Tests limited to the teacher's school; coloured profile icons by plan.
Missing profile details are asked for right after sign-in; teachers can add a school that is not in the list.
Save as worksheet and Create test in DPPs, PYQs and Must Solve.
School chosen from a list; Avanti ID students' details come from the Avanti list.
Must Solve open to everyone; handouts open in a viewer.
Category and gender added to student details.
Sign in with Google or Student ID; Free, Premium and Avanti plans.
Online tests with a share link, exam window, reports with ranks, and teacher results.
